# knowledge proficiency interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/knowledgeProficiencyInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The interval over which a knowledge-proficiency held; closing it (rather than deleting) records lapsed knowledge ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). Non-functional. Lighter cases use gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyInterval.md) from [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Knowledge Proficiency

- **Source:** [`slices/core/cognition/examples/knowledge-proficiency.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/cognition/examples/knowledge-proficiency.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-knowledge-proficiency)#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-knowledge-proficiency

```turtle
# --- Promote to a reified proficiency: depth read on an explicit named SCALE,
#     over a temporal interval. The flat hasMastered above and this relator
#     coexist; gmeow:pairsWith links the two forms.
ex:adaPython a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent    ex:ada ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject  wd:Q28865 ;       # Python
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel    gmeow:knowledgeMastered ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale    gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval ex:adaPythonSince ;
    gmeow:displayable true .

# --- Suppression, not deletion (Principle 10): Ada once understood a framework she
#     has since let lapse. The proficiency is RETAINED with a CLOSED interval and
#     gmeow:displayable false — what she knew WHEN stays a query, not an erasure.
ex:adaBioinf a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent    ex:ada ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject  wd:Q189436 ;      # bioinformatics
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel    gmeow:knowledgeUnderstands ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale    gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval ex:adaBioinfPast ;
    gmeow:displayable false .                            # lapsed — withheld, not deleted
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the temporal-scope player of a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) relator when the period a depth held is itself first-class — and to record lapsed knowledge by CLOSING the interval rather than deleting the proficiency ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the lighter case where a single validity span suffices (use [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) on the statement instead) and avoid ever deleting a relator to express forgetting — close the interval or set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyInterval.md) at a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) (non-functional — several spans may attach); close the interval to suppress lapsed knowledge while keeping what the agent knew when as a query ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).
